verses.text: A dry bite of bread in peace beats a house full of food and fighting.
A servant who acts wisely will end up in charge of a son who brings shame. That servant will get a share of the inheritance alongside the brothers.
A refining pot tests silver, and a furnace tests gold. The LORD tests hearts.
Someone set on doing wrong listens closely to wicked talk. A liar perks up at words that stir up trouble.
Mock poor people and you insult the one who made you. Celebrate when disaster hits and you'll face punishment.
Grandkids are the crown of old men, and children take pride in their parents.
Fine speech sounds out of place coming from a fool. Lies sound even worse coming from a ruler.
A bribe looks like a jewel to the person giving it. Everywhere they turn, it seems to get them what they want.
Let an offense go and you'll help love grow. Keep bringing it up and you'll split up the closest of friends.
One sharp correction sinks deeper into someone with understanding than a hundred lashes do into a fool.
An evil person wants nothing but rebellion, so a ruthless messenger will be sent against them.
You'd be better off running into a bear whose cubs were taken than meeting a fool in the middle of their foolishness.
Pay someone back with evil for the good they did, and evil will never leave your house.
Starting a fight is like punching a hole in a dam. Back off before the argument breaks loose.
Clearing the wicked and condemning people who've done right both disgust the LORD.
What good is money in a fool's hand to buy wisdom when they haven't got the sense to learn?
A friend loves you through every season. A brother is born to be there when trouble hits.
It takes a person with no sense to shake hands and put themselves up as security for their neighbor.
Love disobedience and you love a fight. Build yourself a high gate and you're asking for ruin.
A twisted heart won't find things going well. A lying tongue will land you in trouble.
Having a fool for a child brings grief. A fool's father gets no joy out of it.
A cheerful heart works like good medicine. A crushed spirit dries you out to the bone.
A wicked person takes a bribe on the quiet to twist justice out of shape.
A person with understanding keeps wisdom in view. A fool's eyes wander clear to the ends of the earth.
A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the mother who gave birth to him.
It's wrong to punish people who've done right or whip officials for acting with integrity.
People who know what they're talking about don't waste words. A person with understanding keeps an even temper.
Even a fool can pass for wise by staying quiet. Close your mouth and people may think you've got good judgment.
